one_liner: Team chat platform with channels, DMs, canvases and workflow apps.
auth_note: OAuth 2.0 yields bot, user and app tokens governed by scopes; token rotation optional.
access_note: Create a Slack app in any workspace (free workspace works); installs on own workspace by default. Marketplace review only needed for public listing.
api_note: Web API method families (chat, conversations, users, files, canvases, search, etc.), Events API and Socket Mode; method count not verified from fetched pages.
mcp_note: Official Slack MCP server at https://mcp.slack.com/mcp; only Marketplace-published or internal apps may use it, unlisted apps prohibited.

evidence.quote: Slack apps use OAuth scopes to govern what they can access.
by default, it can only be installed on your own workspace.

one_liner: Cloud communications APIs for SMS, voice, video, email and verification.
auth_note: Account SID + Auth Token via HTTP Basic; API keys are the preferred method.
access_note: Free trial account gives Account SID/Auth Token immediately (same credentials after upgrade); trial has messaging/calling restrictions and real sending needs paid balance.
api_note: Over 1,800 endpoints across 30+ products per Twilio MCP page (messaging, voice, verify, conversations, etc.).
mcp_note: Official Twilio MCP at https://mcp.twilio.com/docs is docs-only (read-only, no account access); twilio-labs/mcp (alpha) exposes API actions using an API key.

evidence.quote: API keys are the preferred way to authenticate with Twilio's REST APIs.
Your Twilio trial account uses the same account credentials (Account SID and Auth Token) that you use after you upgrade.
it does not connect to a Twilio account or execute any API calls.

access_note: Free Cliq plan signup exists; register client in Zoho API Console to get client ID/secret. Org-level scopes may need admin.
api_note: REST API v3 with scopes for bots, teams, users, departments, reminders, datastores, commands, widgets, schedulers, extensions, media sessions.
mcp_note: Official Zoho Cliq MCP server (via Zoho MCP), zoho.com/cliq/help/platform/zoho-cliq-mcp.html; tools page lists tools.

evidence.quote: Zoho Cliq API uses the OAuth 2.0 protocol for authentication.
registering your app with the Zoho API console

api_note: Open Platform server APIs: IM messages/chats, contacts, calendar, docs/drive, sheets, base, approval, tasks; endpoint count not fetched.
mcp_note: Official larksuite/lark-openapi-mcp (lark-mcp, app_id/app_secret or OAuth); remote hosted MCP mode marked deprecated.

api_note: API addon covers send/reply/delete messages, reactions, create channel, list channel messages and channels/DMs; Swagger docs.
mcp_note: Official Pumble MCP at https://mcp.pumble.com/mcp with scope-based prompts (channels:read, messages:write, channels:write).

one_liner: Community chat platform with servers, channels, voice and bots.
auth_note: Bot token (Authorization: Bot ...) for bots; OAuth2 for user-authorized access.
access_note: Create an application in the Developer Portal for free, add a bot to get a token; privileged intents / large-bot verification not verified from fetched pages.
api_note: HTTP API at discord.com/api plus Gateway websocket: guilds, channels, messages, members, roles, interactions, webhooks.
mcp_note: Discord does not publish an official MCP server; community servers (e.g. SaseQ/discord-mcp) use a bot token.

evidence.quote: When you create a bot user in the Developer Portal, Discord generates a bot token.

one_liner: Messaging app with a free Bot API for building bots.
auth_note: Bot token obtained from @BotFather, passed in the URL of HTTPS Bot API calls.
access_note: Contact @BotFather to create a bot and get a token instantly; no approval or payment.
api_note: Bot API: send/edit messages and media, inline mode, payments, webhooks/getUpdates, chat admin, stickers. MTProto client API is separate.
mcp_note: No official Telegram MCP found; community servers exist (e.g. chigwell/telegram-mcp via Telethon, API ID/hash).

one_liner: Meta's WhatsApp Business Platform Cloud API for business messaging.
auth_note: Bearer access tokens: temporary test token or permanent System User token; OAuth/Embedded Signup for providers serving other businesses.
access_note: Meta developer account and test number are self-serve; production needs Meta Business verification, phone number registration, approved templates (App Review when serving other businesses).
api_note: Graph API: send messages/templates/media, phone numbers, templates, webhooks, business profile.
mcp_note: Meta WhatsApp Business Tools MCP (developers.facebook.com/documentation/mcp/whatsapp-business-tools-mcp), beta, OAuth sign-in; can send messages and manage templates/webhooks.
blocker_note: Production needs Business verification/app review; free-form messages only in 24-hour window, templates require approval.

evidence.quote: Create a system user and generate a permanent access token
If you are a direct developer, meaning only you or your business accesses your own data, use a System User access token.
